theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Modified for Dark Mode)
theme_and_archetype.mood: Serious, efficient, authoritative, data-dense, and clean.
core_principles: Density & Clarity: Eliminate 'zoomed in' feel by using text-sm as base, tighter paddings (p-4 instead of p-6/8), and strict table column widths to prevent horizontal scrolling.
Tab-Driven Navigation: Shift from modal/popup drill-downs to a persistent browser-style tab system for data views.
Unified Aesthetic: Force the entire app into the dark 'Sales Console' theme. Convert any light pages (e.g., Payments) to dark mode immediately.

badges_and_pills.system_rules: Eliminate scatter of font sizes. Use exactly these three variants based on context.

small.usage: Inside dense data tables or tight lists.

default.usage: Standard KPI headers, status indicators next to H2s.

spacing_and_density.global_padding: p-4 md:p-5 (Reduced from typical p-6/p-8 to fix 'zoomed in' feel)
spacing_and_density.gap_system: gap-4 for major structural blocks, gap-2 for internal widget elements.

tables.overflow: Use text-ellipsis overflow-hidden max-w-[150px] to prevent horizontal scroll. Add native title tooltips for truncated data.

tab_system.location: Desktop/Tablet: Sits immediately below the top nav bar (or alongside it), above the main view. Mobile: Hidden, rely on stack navigation.
tab_system.container: flex items-end h-10 w-full bg-zinc-900 border-b border-zinc-800 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar

tab_item.active: h-full flex items-center gap-2 px-4 bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-100 border-r border-zinc-800 border-t-2 border-t-emerald-500 min-w-[120px] max-w-[200px] cursor-default relative group
tab_item.inactive: h-full flex items-center gap-2 px-4 bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 border-r border-zinc-800 border-t border-t-transparent hover:bg-zinc-800 min-w-[120px] max-w-[200px] cursor-pointer relative group transition-colors

tab_system.elements_inside_tab: Favicon-sized Lucide icon (w-3.5 h-3.5), Tab Title (text-xs truncate), Close Button (w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 hover:text-rose-400 transition-opacity)
tab_system.functionality: Tabs must preserve state. Use a React state array of objects {id, type, title, data, isActive}. Clicking sidebar items adds to this array or sets existing to active.

metric_drill_view.usage: Replaces popups for Revenue Closed, Open Pipeline, etc.
metric_drill_view.layout: flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto p-5 gap-6
metric_drill_view.header: flex justify-between items-end. Left: H1 + Overline. Right: Date filters/actions.
metric_drill_view.kpi_ribbon: grid grid-cols-4 gap-4. Cards use bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 p-4 rounded-lg.
metric_drill_view.data_table: Full-width Shadcn Table. Strict column widths. No horizontal scroll on desktop.

agent_detail_view.usage: Replaces popups when clicking an Agent's name.
agent_detail_view.left_column: col-span-4. Profile card, Won vs Target progress bar (emerald), Contact info.
agent_detail_view.right_column: col-span-8. Pipeline by stage (Recharts), Recent Activity list, Assigned Leads table.

motion_and_interactions.tabs: If possible, use @dnd-kit/core or framer-motion for drag-and-drop tab reordering. If complex, standard click-to-switch is MVP.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and list items must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-zinc-100).
motion_and_interactions.modals: Only use standard Shadcn Dialogs for input/actions (New Payment Link, Add Agent). Data viewing is strictly Tabs.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Review existing layout structure. Insert the new TabStrip component right above the main children render area.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a TabContext or global state (Zustand/Redux) to manage open tabs: { tabs: [], activeTabId: null }.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Intercept clicks on metrics ('Revenue Closed') and Agent names. Prevent modal opening. Instead, dispatch an action to add a new tab to the state and set it as active.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Convert the existing 'Payments' page from Light mode to Dark mode by mapping white backgrounds to zinc-950 and dark text to zinc-100.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Implement standard Badge variants. Search and replace all arbitrary text-[9px] and inline styled pills with the new Badge system.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Adjust all container paddings to p-4/p-5 to fix the 'zoomed in' feeling, and set body font size to text-sm.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: IMPORTANT: Use .js files for React components, not .tsx.
